Name: Fathomless Eruption
Description: A massive column of boiling steam erupts from a point you designate within range. Each creature in a cylinder that is 60-foot tall with a 10-foot radius must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 4d10 fire damage, or half as much on a success. This fire damage cannot be resisted as a result of being underwater.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level.
